game.name: Ben 10 Ultimate Alien : Cosmic Destruction (USA)
game.desc: Ben 10 Ultimate Alien: Cosmic Destruction on Xbox 360 is a third-person action game. Lead Ben as well as Glacial, Arachno-monkey, Enormosaurus, Echo Echo and Regenerator in their ultimate forms as well as a surprise alien exclusive to the Xbox 360. The adventure takes you from Tokyo to Rome in search of Galvin artefacts to save the earth from a cosmic storm that could destroy it.
